risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 180.8 crisis level, CPI event today) creates severe headwinds for tech equities; 76-day earnings window provides some buffer but risk environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price is at 52-week highs with strong uptrend structure (above all major MAs) and elevated momentum (RSI 9 overbought + rising, Stoch K 82.33) suggesting continuation potential if breakout holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought extremes without fresh crossover confirmation, extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, CPI event today), zero fundamental catalysts, and exhaustion-level volume spike create severe pullback/reversal risk that outweighs technical strength.
